The dependency graph shows that checkoutservice calls paymentservice (via ChargeServ), and frontend calls checkoutservice. When paymentservice rejects charges due to an overly restrictive credit card validation policy, checkout flows fail, which cascades up through checkoutservice to the frontend. All other services are marked red but show only normal memory/network metrics without any application errors \u2014 their red status is likely a consequence of the broader checkout flow being broken (e.g., increased retries, backed-up requests, or health check failures propagating). The error originates in charge.js:74 in paymentservice, suggesting a recent code change or configuration update tightened the accepted credit card types to exclude visa_electron (and potentially other card types), causing transaction failures. This is likely tied to a recent deployment or code change to the paymentservice that modified the credit card validation logic."}
